title: Detecting Soft Errors in Parallel Software with LLM-tuned Instruction Duplication
abstract: arXiv:2609.19531v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose PaRID (PaRallel Instruction Duplication), a software-directed soft error detection framework that requires only compile-time effort for multithreading parallel programs. PaRID addresses two key challenges: supporting parallel programs with mixed serial and parallel regions and minimizing performance overhead without relying on costly dynamic profiling. It combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling, guided by eight generalizable findings from an offline characterization study, to enable fast soft error detection in parallel applications. Evaluation on NPB benchmarks shows that PaRID reduces protection overhead from 162.79% to 59.84% on average and achieves up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.

translated_title: 基于大语言模型调优指令复制的并行软件软错误检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PaRID（并行指令复制），一个仅需编译时工作即可适用于多线程并行程序的软件导向软错误检测框架。PaRID解决了两个关键挑战：支持具有混合串行与并行区域的并行程序，以及在不依赖昂贵动态剖析的情况下最小化性能开销。它将并行感知的代码转换与大语言模型调优的性能建模相结合，并以离线特性研究得出的八条可泛化发现为指导，从而在并行应用中实现快速的软错误检测。在NPB基准测试上的评估表明，PaRID将保护开销平均从162.79%降至59.84%，实现了高达5倍的加速，同时保持了完整的错误检测有效性。
tldr: PaRID是一种仅需编译时开销的并行程序软错误检测框架，通过结合并行感知代码转换与LLM调优的性能建模，在保持完整错误检测能力的同时，将保护开销平均降至59.84%，并获得高达5倍的加速。
en_tdlr: PaRID is a soft error detection framework for parallel programs requiring only compile-time effort, which combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling to reduce protection overhead to 59.84% on average and achieve up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.
